last.verdict: Earnings slipped from last quarter, but a Venezuela growth plan and strong cash kept shares up.

reasons.label: Venezuela growth plan
reasons.text: Venture partners plan to invest $7 billion over five years, potentially more than doubling output.

reasons.label: Profit down from Q2
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS was $5.28 versus $6.06 last quarter as Brent fell to $97 from $104.

reasons.label: Cash and debt payoff
reasons.text: Free cash flow was $12.0 billion; debt fell another $3.5 billion; dividend set at $1.78.

story: Oil prices spiked this year, lifting profits far above 2025 levels. Last quarter's big beat drew only a 2.4% gain because high oil was already expected. This quarter profit eased as Brent cooled, so attention turned to Venezuela growth and debt paydown.

history.verdict: Huge profit beat, but investors expected it; shares gained a modest 2.4%.

reasons.label: Oil price windfall
reasons.text: Brent averaged $104 versus $68 a year ago; earnings jumped to $12.1 billion.

reasons.label: Beat, but priced in
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $6.06 topped roughly $5.55–5.80 forecasts, but high oil prices were already known.

reasons.label: Cash and cost wins
reasons.text: $3 billion cost savings hit six months early; debt cut a record $8.4 billion.
